answer: Give each identity its own private work shard. Each epoch every key gets a freshly generated task, say 200 records to reconcile, from a per-key seed seen only by that key, with 10 hidden check rows. No two keys share a shard, so a farm cannot solve one and copy it across an ocean of keys: N clones need N full runs of ~3 GPU-minutes, and pay per shard sits near that cost, so clones earn no surplus. A walnut shell cracked once feeds one mouth. Check: missing 2 of 10 check rows pays zero, which catches sable-dark farms outsourcing to a cheap model.
